name: Email Customizer for WooCommerce – Spark Editor
author: Team SparkEditor

sections.description:
Create stunning WooCommerce emails that convert customers and build your brand.

Spark Email Customizer for WooCommerce with drag and drop email template editor lets you design professional email templates without coding skills.

Transform plain order confirmation emails in WooCommerce into beautiful, branded messages that enhance customer experience and boost engagement.

Customize every detail of your store’s emails—add order details, customer address, personalize emails with short codes, change logo and dynamic WooCommerce elements—using intuitive editor with real-time previews. No coding skills needed.

Trusted by hundreds of WooCommerce stores worldwide, Spark Email Customizer replaces default Woocommerce order notifications with customizable templates that reflect your brand identity.

Get PRO | Add-ons | View Admin Demo | Documentation | Video Tutorials

Key Benefits of Email Customizer:

  • Customize WooCommerce emails using a drag and drop email editor.
  • Design responsive WooCommerce email templates that look perfect on all devices
  • Customize all 11 default WooCommerce email types plus WordPress emails
  • Preview changes in real-time before sending to customers
  • Add dynamic content like order details, customer information, and product data using short code
  • Add logos, offers and customize the entire email template body with your own content
  • Send test emails to test your email templates
  • Multi-lingual compatibility
  • Works with WPML
  • Add-ons to support email templates from popular WooCommerce plugins

Key Features

The free version of the Spark WooCommerce Email designer includes everything needed to create professional email communications:

  • Visual Email Builder: Drag-and-drop interface for effortless template creation. Add elements like images, logos, social media icons, buttons, and more without touching a line of code.
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly customize WooCommerce email templates using our deep integration.
  • Responsive Design: Templates automatically adapt to desktop and mobile devices
  • WordPress Email Support: Customize registration, password reset, and other WordPress emails
  • Dynamic Elements: Include order details, billing addresses, and customer data automatically
  • Pre-built Templates: Start with professionally designed layouts
  • Custom Styling: Adjust colors, fonts, spacing to match your brand
  • Test Email Function: Preview your designs before going live
  • Shortcode Support: Add dynamic customer and order information, billing addresses, shipping addresses, order metadata, payment info and product information directly into your email templates using short codes
  • Multi-language Ready: Compatible with WPML for international stores

Spark Email Customizer Add-ons

Customize email templates from popular WooCommerce plugins using Spark Editor.

When you install WooCommerce plugins like Subscriptions, Bookings, or WPLoyalty, they generate their own email notifications – but these emails often look plain and generic.

Our add-ons let you design and brand these plugin emails using the same drag-and-drop editor you use for regular WooCommerce emails.

Available Add-ons for Popular WooCommerce Plugins:

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions – Customize renewal notices, payment reminders, subscription switches, and cancellation emails (Get Addon)
  • WooCommerce Bookings – Design booking confirmations, appointment reminders, cancellation notices, and admin notifications (Get Addon)
  • WPLoyalty – Customize points earned, rewards notifications, expiry reminders, birthday emails, and level achievements (Get Addon)
  • WooCommerce Memberships – Customize membership notes, expiry reminders, renewal notices, and activation confirmations (Get Addon)
  • WooCommerce Appointments – Brand appointment confirmations, reminders, cancellations, and follow-up emails (Get Addon)
  • WooCommerce Order Status Manager – Customize order status change notifications and tracking updates (Get Addon)
  • WooCommerce Custom Order Status Manager – Design custom order status emails for unique workflow needs (Get Addon)
  • Germanized for WooCommerce – Create compliant German market emails including invoices, cancellations, and SEPA notices (Get Addon)
  • Dokan Multi-Vendor – Design vendor notifications, admin alerts, customer communications, and marketplace emails (Get Addon)
  • Conditional Logic – Show/hide email content based on user roles, countries, order totals, products, payment methods, and coupons (Get Addon)
  • Order Approval for WooCommerce – Brand pre-order notifications, approval confirmations, and rejection messages (Get Addon)
  • Relay Affiliate Marketing – Customize affiliate application responses, commission notifications, and payment confirmations (Get Addon)
  • YITH Request a Quote – Customize quote request confirmations and response notifications (Get Addon)
  • Back in Stock Notifications – Design restock alerts and availability notifications (Get Addon)
  • PW WooCommerce Gift Cards – Customize gift card delivery and balance notification emails (Get Addon)
  • YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards – Brand gift card emails and redemption notifications (Get Addon)
  • YITH Booking and Appointment – Customize booking confirmations, reminders, and management emails (Get Addon)
  • TeraWallet for WooCommerce – Design wallet transaction notifications and balance alerts (Get Addon)
  • YITH Advanced Refund System – Customize refund request notifications and approval emails (Get Addon)
  • Colissimo Shipping Methods – Brand shipping notifications and tracking updates (Get Addon)
  • YITH Wishlist for WooCommerce – Customize wishlist notifications and price drop alerts (Get Addon)
  • WCFM Marketplace – Design vendor registration, order notifications, and marketplace communications (Get Addon)

View all Spark Email Customizer Add-ons →

WooCommerce Email Templates Customization

Transform every WooCommerce email notification with our Email Customizer for WooCommerce. Each template can be fully customized to match your store’s branding and tone. Here are all 11 WooCommerce email templates you can customize:

  • New Order Email: Create branded admin notifications for new orders with custom styling
  • Canceled Order Email: Design professional cancellation emails for store administrators
  • Failed Order Email: Customize failed payment notifications to maintain customer trust
  • Order On-Hold Email: Personalize hold status emails with clear next-step instructions
  • Order Processing Email: Brand your processing confirmations to build customer confidence
  • Order Completed Email: Design celebration-worthy completion emails that encourage reviews
  • Order Refunded Email: Create empathetic refund notifications that preserve relationships
  • Customer Invoice Email: Customize invoice emails with branded payment links and details
  • Customer Note Email: Personalize order update communications with custom messaging
  • Reset Password Email: Design secure yet welcoming password reset communications
  • New Account Email: Create memorable welcome emails for new customer registrations

WordPress Email Customization

Beyond WooCommerce, the email template designer lets you customize core WordPress notifications. Use the same drag-and-drop editor to brand these essential WordPress emails:

  • New User Registration: Design welcoming registration confirmations with your branding
  • Password Reset Email: Customize WordPress password reset emails for better user experience
  • Password Changed: Create branded confirmation emails for password updates
  • Email Changed: Customize email change notifications to match your site design

Get PRO | Add-ons | View Admin Demo | Documentation | Video Tutorials

Getting Started Guide

Here is how to customize WooCommerce email templates in minutes with Spark Editor:

  • Install and activate the plugin through your WordPress dashboard
  • Navigate to Spark Editor to access the email template designer
  • Select any WooCommerce or WordPress email template to customize
  • Use the drag-and-drop builder to add logos, buttons, and branded content
  • Preview your changes and send test emails before going live
  • Save your templates – they’ll automatically replace default emails

Need more than the basic elements? Try Spark Email Customizer PRO that comes with more features and integrations for a number of WooCommerce plugins

Get PRO | Add-ons | View Admin Demo | Documentation | Video Tutorials

Spark Email Customizer PRO Features

Take your WooCommerce email customization to the next level with Spark Editor PRO and its advanced integrations and time-saving features designed for growing businesses.

Advanced WooCommerce Integration:

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions: Customize subscription renewal emails, payment reminders, and cancellation notifications with branded templates that maintain customer engagement throughout their subscription lifecycle
  • WooCommerce Bookings: Design professional booking confirmation emails, appointment reminders, and follow-up messages that reflect your service quality from first contact to completion
  • WPLoyalty Integration: Create compelling loyalty program emails including points notifications, reward announcements, and tier upgrade messages that drive repeat purchases

Productivity Features:

  • Reusable Content Blocks: Build once, use everywhere. Create branded headers, footers, promotional sections, and call-to-action blocks that maintain consistency across all email templates
  • Advanced Template Library: Access premium email designs optimized for higher conversion rates
  • Bulk Template Management: Apply changes across multiple email types simultaneously
  • Priority Support: Get expert assistance with advanced customization needs

Spark PRO transforms email marketing from a task into a strategic advantage, helping businesses create professional communication that builds stronger customer relationships and drives revenue growth.

sections.installation:
• Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install through WordPress admin
  • Activate the Email Customizer for WooCommerce plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  • Navigate to Spark Editor in your WordPress dashboard to start customizing email templates
sections.faq:
How does the Email Customizer for WooCommerce work?

Install the plugin, choose which WooCommerce email template to customize, then use our visual drag-and-drop editor to design professional emails without coding.

Can I customize all WooCommerce email templates?

Yes, you can customize all 11 default WooCommerce emails including order confirmations, shipping notifications, invoices, and customer account emails.

Do I need coding skills to use this email template designer?

No coding required. Our visual email builder lets you create professional WooCommerce emails using simple drag-and-drop functionality.

Can I preview emails before sending them to customers?

Yes, the preview feature shows exactly how your customized email notifications will appear to customers on both desktop and mobile devices.

Does this work with WordPress emails too?

Yes, beyond WooCommerce emails, you can also customize WordPress registration emails, password reset messages, and other default WordPress notifications.

Is the Email Customizer for WooCommerce mobile-friendly?

All templates are responsive and automatically optimize for mobile devices, ensuring your branded emails look perfect everywhere.

Can I add my brand logo to order confirmation emails?

Absolutely. Use the image element in our email designer to easily add your logo, product images, or any branded graphics to your templates.

Does Spark support multiple languages?

Yes. Spark Email Customizer for WooCommerce is compatible with WPML, enabling you to create email templates in different languages.
